title: People Make Better Edits: Measuring the Efficacy of LLM-Generated Counterfactually Augmented Data for Harmful Language Detection
reasoning: The paper directly evaluates and benchmarks models for 'Harmful Language Detection' (sexism and hate speech), which involves ethical judgments about what constitutes harmful content. It discusses unintended biases towards marginalized communities and explores the conceptualization of gender in sexism detection, indicating a core focus beyond mere mentions of ethics. Section H.2 details instructions for classifying hate speech based on identity, religion, gender, etc., and mentions ethical values.
